cards.question: When is a type T Send?
cards.answer: If its ownership can be transferred to another thread.

cards.question: When is a type T Sync?
cards.answer: If its shared reference is Send — that is, T is Sync if &T is Send.

cards.question: Are primitive types Send and Sync?
cards.answer: Yes. All primitive types are Send and Sync.

cards.question: When are composite types automatically Send and Sync?
cards.answer: When all of their fields are Send and Sync.
